AN ACT in relation to establishing the legislative task force on responsible
gaming
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1978

SPONSOR: ADDABBO
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act in relation to establishing the legislative task force on respon-
sible gaming

 
PURPOSE:

To promote responsible gaming and mitigate risks and consequences asso-
ciated with problem gambling.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

This legislation will establish the New York State Legislative Task
Force on responsible gaming which will provide recommendations to the
New York State Gaming Commission and each Division on issues related to
the prevention and treatment of problem Gambling.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The recently enacted 2012-2013 New York State budget amended the state
Constitution to allow for non-tribal casino gaming in New York and also
included provisions to merge the Division of Lottery and the Racing and
Wagering Board creating the New York State Gaming Commission.

The Commission will be comprised of an Executive Director and seven
members that must have no less than five years administrative experience
in public or business administration and one or more qualifications in
the following areas: (1) significant service as a certified public
accountant; (2) knowledge of corporate finance and securities; (3)
professional experience in gaming regulation administration or manage-
ment; and (4) experience in fields of criminal investigation, law, or
law enforcement.

While New York State appears to have the necessary structure in place to
ensure casino gaming will be properly regulated; be profitable finan-
cially, and maintain integrity and fairness with all gaming activity,
there remains no internal controls to make certain that gaming policies
which promote responsible gaming practices exist, This bill will estab-
lish a legislative taskforce on responsible gaming. This task force will
provide the knowledge and expertise to assist the New York State Gaming
Commission and its divisions to develop policies and procedures that
foster responsible gaming practices by gaming facilities and mitigate
the risks or consequences associated with problem gambling.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2017: S3067A - PASSED IN THE SENATE
2018: S3067A - PASSED IN THE SENATE

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

Undetermined

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 158
 
TO THE SENATE:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:
 
Senate Bill Number 1978-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  in  relation to establishing the legislative task force on
      responsible gaming"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  This bill, which was initially introduced in 2012, would  establish  a
legislative  task  force  on responsible gaming. The task force would be
responsible for identifying policies  and  programs  that  mitigate  the
risks  and  consequences  associated  with compulsive gambling. The task
force would also be responsible for identifying and recommending respon-
sible gaming practices  to  be  included  in  the  enabling  legislation
authorizing casino style gaming facilities in New York State.

  Problem  gambling  is a serious issue, which is why the New York State
Gaming Commission makes it a priority to tackle this issue head  on.  In
doing  so, the Commission received the World Lottery Association's Level
4 certification, their highest,  for  their  work  on  problem  gambling
across  all  four  of  its  divisions: lottery, horse racing, commercial
gaming, and charitable gaming. Furthermore, the enabling statute author-
izing casino style  gaming  facilities  for  which  the  task  force  is
supposed  to  make  recommendations  was signed into law in 2013, making
this bill unnecessary and untimely. For these reasons, I am  constrained
to veto this bill.
 
  The bill is disapproved.                    (signed) ANDREW M. CUOMO
 
                               __________
